name.pt-BR: A Vida Espiritual e a Oração

description.en-US: The Spiritual Life and Prayer according to Holy Scripture and Monastic Tradition, by the first abbess of Sainte-Cécile de Solesmes, translated by the nuns of Stanbrook Abbey (1900).
description.pt-BR: A vida espiritual e a oração segundo a Sagrada Escritura e a tradição monástica, da primeira abadessa de Sainte-Cécile de Solesmes, na tradução inglesa das monjas de Stanbrook (1900).

sources.description: The Stanbrook translation (London and Leamington, 1900), as reprinted by Mediatrix Press (2016). Text read from the scans with dots.mocr and proofread page by page by Claude against them (research/ocr-books).
